reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that reduces tool-schema context overhead by progressively hiding long-tail tools and exposing search, description, and real-tool invocation on demand.

summaries.zh: 通过渐进式披露按需搜索、加载和调用工具，减少 DeepSeek Harness 中大型工具目录占用的模型上下文。
summaries.en: Reduces model context usage in DeepSeek Harness by progressively disclosing tools and enabling on-demand search, schema loading, and invocation.

capabilities: Reduces the model-visible tool catalog using tiered disclosure
Searches and ranks deferred tools with an optional rerank API and keyword fallback
Loads deferred tool schemas into the active context
Invokes deferred tools by their real names through the host tool executor
Reads and hot-reloads user or project configuration
